items.text: Kobu bobo akirot naka EJAKAIT mama ajai ebe:
“Okoku loka etuŋanan, ajaas aŋor aarei, totokec adiopet:
kiporoto Misiri; kiporoto koiditeukec: koridakinai ikecekisin kaŋina, kieikakis atibolok nuka abekonutukec kaŋina.
Ikecekiroria Akola nakapolon, ka Akoliba kinacike. Koraut nukaŋ, kouriata idwe lusap ka Iupesur. Ikeeekiroria da, Samaria ŋes Akola, Yerusalem da ijes Akoliba.
“Kiporo Akola nakeraar nakan; kikila ipailonoke, Iyasurian ikeidunyeta.
Lukenapenenete lubulului, ikayaitok ka ijaka, kes kere ikarumunak luimielai, ikebwanenok luibwanenete ibalasin.
Kokorak kes akedoteu, kes kere, ituŋa luseuna luka Asuria: ka ŋol da lokikila ŋesi, komunaar kaputosiakee kere.
Kwabo mam kinyeini akedoteu anyoun kapaarasia nuka Misiri; naarai koperoto kaŋes katumunike, kicikakis atiboloka nuka abekonutuke: kobukokis ŋes akeeedoteu.
Ŋes kakorakinia akanin nuka ipailonoke, akanin nuka Iyasurian, lukikila.
Kopukosi nul amujalalake: koyanaasi ikedwe lusap ka lupesur, koara ŋes kekilen: koraun naejenio kanor; naarai aponi kotubokinai akiro.
“Koany kinacike da Akoliba nun, konye kiteleka ŋesi ŋin kapaar naka eikilike, kotoma adoteuke da naitelekarit adoteu naka inacike.
Kikila Iyasurian, ikayaitok ka ijaka, ikeidunyeta, lukenapenenete lukaibuses naepol, ikebwanenok luibwanenete ibalasin, kes kere ikatumunak luimielai.
Kaany ebe emunaara; kotupasi kesi kere edioperor,
Konye kiyatak ŋesi akedoteu: naarai koany ituŋa lukinomakinitai arwatat, aputosia nuka Ikaludean nukinomitai keiese Ioirananai.
Koenitos arokoban aŋabesikec, kienienito akwesikee kigoen lukijesesinei, kes kere kotakanete kwape ikapolok, kwape ejaar aput naka Ibabulonin luka Kaludea, akwap nakobukec,
Napaanyunia kes kikila, kiyakik ikiyakia koKaludea,
Kopotu Ibabulonin mama ejai ŋesi kaperis naka amin, komunaasi ŋes kadoteukec, komunaar kakes, kopianik eketau kes.
Kwaŋin kopuko akedoteu, kopuko da akemujalal: kopianik ekatau ŋes, kwape apianikinia ekatau kinacike.
Konye kiyatak adoteuke, kiitu apaarasia nuka atumunike, nueporoo kakwap nako Misiri.
Kikila ipailonokec, kosubito awatekec bala awat nuka asigiria, kosubite aurikec bala aur naka ibalasin.
Kwaŋin iitunit adoteu naka atumunikon, nakieikakiniata Imisirian aiburun naka atibolokakon nuka atumunikon.
“Aso do, inera kwanata Ejakait EDEKE ebe: Ŋo Akoliba, koany, etonyouni ipailonokon asurokin jo, luapianiki ekonitau, ayauni kes asurokin jo kowaitin kere;
Ibabulonin, ka Ikaludean kere, Pekod ka Soa, ka Koa, ka Iyasurian kere nepepe kakes: ikatumunak luimielai, kes kere ikayaitok ka ijaka, ikapolok ka ituŋa luejenikina, kes kere ibwanenito ibalasin.

Epote kesi asurokin jo ekapitos luiiis, kagalin, ka nukakokoron, ka atukot naka ituŋa; iderakioos ejie kaio kojaas kiupalin ka ibukwi ka akopiran owaitin kere: adakakini kes atubokin akiro, kitubokinete kwape ejaatar itubesiakec.
Ederakini ekokoteka asurokin jo, kiticanete kadeden. Kituborete ikumesikon, ka akiikon; irikakini ekileŋ akonitutubet oaesali. Eyaŋaarete idwekon lusap ka lupesur; icweio akonitutubet naesali kakim.
Kwaŋin etanania akonidoteu, ka eporokon lokolo iyauni kakwap nako Misiri: tetere mam iteluori akonikonye mamakee, karaida akiitun bobo Misiri.
Naarai inera kwanata Ejakait EDEKE ebe: Koany, kakorakini jo akanin nuka nul kaluireit, akanin nuka ŋul kaluapianiki etaukon.
Kiswamakinete jo nukanar, kidemarete aitaaritoikon kere, kijalakinete imujalal atitai: epukorio amuialal naka adoteukon. Eporokon ka adoteukon kere
kiswamakinito kwaŋin naarai ibu kiporo mama ejaas ikapirin, ido naarai imunaar kaputosiakec.
Ibu kotupa erot loka inacikoo; ŋes kainakinia akolike akanikon.
Naarai ebala Ejakait EDEKE ebe, Eoŋ ener.
Aso inera kwanata Ejakait EDEKE ebe: Naarai kimurwok eoŋ, koeaka eoŋ kaukon, asa do jo da kibwok eporokon ka adoteukon.”
Bobo da kalimok EJAKAIT eoŋ ebe: “Okoku loka etuŋanan, itubokini kereka Akola ka Akoliba? Aso kolimok kes italesiakec,
Naarai adoteata, ejaas aokot akaninikec; adoteata aputosiakec; ido etotoroto ikecedwe lusap lukawurikinete akim ainakin nun ainyam.
Ido oobo keswamakis eoŋ nu: amunaasi akaibois nakalaunan apaaran ŋipeŋin, amunaasi da akasabaton.
Naarai kedautu aarakin ikecedwe mama ejaas aputosiakee, kosodete alomar aiboisika nakalaunan kapaaran kaŋin amunaar. Ido koany, kwape kwaŋin eswamaata kotogoka.
Ido bobo ijukakis anyaraun ituŋa luepote kama elwana: luejukakinio ekiyakia, ido koany, kopotu. Kilon kanuka nul, kojuk akonyekon, kisir lukisiro.
Kiboikin aperis nanepuk, kitemonokinitete emesa kinarenike, loibwaikinit lukisupurununoka ka akakinyet.
Kojai eporoto loka ekodet loijamamai kaŋes: koyaunai ikamerak anyoun kamodiŋ nepepe kimukopin; kitanapai ŋun aikomon akaninikec, ka abokoi da nuejok akwesikee.
“Kasodi eoŋ einer nuka nin naemoionikinit adoteu ebe, Kwana edoteete kaŋes, ŋin da kakes.
Kolomasi mama ejai, kwape elomariata mama ejai naadote. Kwape kwaŋin kelomariata mama ejai Akola ka Akoliba, aŋor nukeporok.
Etubokinete ikadolitok ŋun akiro kwape etubokinere nudotea, ido kwape etubokinere aŋor nuebukorete aokot; naarai eraas nudotea, ejaas aokot akaninikee.”
Naarai ebala kwanata Ejakait EDEKE ebe: “Etonyoikini kes ekodet, kainakin aiiliilio ka anatario.
Ibiribirei kes ekodet kamor, icutarete kikilenakec; earete ikecedwe lusap ka lupesur, ieweete ikecetogoi kakim.
Kwaŋin etanania eporo kakwap, tetere isisianakinio aŋor kere kinyeis arokor eporokus.
Ido kitacakinio eporokus, ibwokete aronisio nuka aputosiakus: ijenunete do ebe arai eoŋ Ejakait EDEKE.
